title: Clockwork Citadel: Siege of the Sable Core
description: A grand steampunk-fantasy assault on a living fortress of brass, steam, and unstable arcane machinery.
intro:
Smoke billows above the skyline as the Clockwork Citadel groans awake.

The Sable Core beneath the fortress has begun to corrupt every gear, gate, and guardian in the city. Friendly engineers still hold a few districts, but the central foundries are overrun. Explore the citadel, recover lost sigils, speak with survivors, and decide whether the great engine will be repaired, shattered, or reborn.

This showcase adventure is built to demonstrate SagaCraft features: combat, equipment, consumables, readable clues, friendly and hostile NPCs, named exits, multi-step quests, and broad interconnected exploration.

rooms.name: Brass Gate Plaza
rooms.description: Once a ceremonial entrance to the citadel, the plaza is now a staging ground littered with broken banners, cooling ash, and snapped chains. Brass statues of forgotten monarchs stare down over the chaos while the main gate pulses with residual heat.

rooms.name: Foundry Promenade
rooms.description: Overhead tracks ferry empty crucibles back and forth, clattering like distant thunder. The air smells of oil, coal, and lightning. This long avenue links the lower city to the citadel’s inner industrial heart.

rooms.name: Gearwright Bazaar
rooms.description: Half-collapsed kiosks are draped with torn blueprints and dangling clockwork trinkets. Even in ruin, the bazaar glitters with invention: brass lenses, spring-loaded tools, and half-finished automata lie everywhere.

rooms.name: Pilgrim Docks
rooms.description: At the western edge of the fortress-city, suspended barges sway over a dizzying gulf. Pilgrims once arrived here to petition the Engine Choir. Now only a cold wind and the hiss of escaping steam answer the bells.

rooms.name: Ember Lift Landing
rooms.description: A huge freight elevator rises through the center of a scorched shaft. Chains thicker than your arm vanish into the shadows above, and a lattice of valves rattles every few seconds with pent-up pressure.

rooms.name: Cog Archive
rooms.description: Tier upon tier of brass cabinets line the walls, each filled with repair ledgers, machine schematics, and decades of engineering notes. The floor has been scattered with copper filings that glitter like frost.

rooms.name: Glass Conservatory
rooms.description: A vaulted greenhouse of crystal panels and iron arches glows with warm amber light. Exotic vines have grown around mechanical irrigation channels, and shattered panes let smoke drift lazily through the canopy.

rooms.name: Flooded Intake Tunnels
rooms.description: These low maintenance passages echo with dripping water and the cough of failing pumps. Pools of black runoff reflect the flicker of broken warning lamps while warped grates rattle underfoot.

rooms.name: Upper Relay Walk
rooms.description: Narrow catwalks lace across the upper furnace vaults, overlooking a sea of rotating pistons and heat chimneys. The whole world seems to tremble beneath your boots as messages once meant for the city’s districts now spark uselessly in the air.

rooms.name: Barracks of the Ash Wardens
rooms.description: Rows of iron bunks and weapon racks stand in military precision, though many have been overturned in a desperate last stand. A handful of surviving wardens left behind armor, maps, and scorched oaths of service.

rooms.name: Whispering Observatory
rooms.description: The observatory dome turns with a soft mechanical hum, aligning lenses toward cracks in the storm-dark sky. Strange whispers slip through the brass speaking tubes, as if the citadel itself is trying to warn you.

rooms.name: Clock Chapel
rooms.description: A chamber of suspended pendulums and polished bronze icons, where engineers once prayed before great repairs. The rhythm here is almost soothing, though one great pendulum has cracked and hangs at an ominous angle.

rooms.name: Sable Engine Antechamber
rooms.description: This circular chamber stands just before the inner reactor vault. Arcane turbines line the walls, their once-orderly glow now spoiled by veins of shadow. A deep pulse beats from beyond the final bulkhead.

rooms.name: Heart of the Sable Core
rooms.description: The core chamber is a cathedral of brass ribs, lightning coils, and rotating rings the size of towers. At its center, a cracked energy sphere leaks black fire into the air, warping everything around it with malignant rhythm.

items.name: Reforged Saber
items.description: A balanced dueling blade reforged from ceremonial steel and brass fittings.

items.name: Field Ration
items.description: A wrapped meal of smoked roots and preserved meat. Not glamorous, but nourishing.

items.name: Ember Ampoule
items.description: A tiny vial of heated tonic favored by foundry workers during long shifts.

items.name: Brass Transit Sigil
items.description: A stamped access emblem that once granted passage through the upper lifts and engine rails.

items.name: Rivetmail Mantle
items.description: A sleeveless coat reinforced with overlapping riveted plates and insulated seams.

items.name: Dockmaster's Ledger
items.description: The final entry reads: 'All outbound lifts halted. Engine corruption spreading. Seal the lower tunnels.'

items.name: Lift Key
items.description: A heavy ignition key etched with the crest of the Ash Wardens.

items.name: Schematic Codex
items.description: Foldout diagrams reveal emergency bypasses, coolant veins, and relay routes inside the citadel.

items.name: Luminous Bloom
items.description: A conservatory flower that stores trace heat in its petals and glows faintly in the dark.

items.name: Pressure Sealant
items.description: A paste-filled tube used to patch ruptured steam conduits before they burst.

items.name: Skyglass Lens
items.description: A polished lens capable of focusing distant light into needle-sharp beams.

items.name: Warden Pike
items.description: A long ash-wood polearm fitted with a triangular brass spearhead.

items.name: Oracle's Note
items.description: 'The core is not dying. It is dreaming badly. Wake it with courage, or end the dream before it swallows the city.'

items.name: Chapel Incense
items.description: Thin aromatic rods still carrying the scent of cedar, copper, and rain.

items.name: Shock Baton
items.description: A crackling control rod once used by the citadel’s enforcers to subdue malfunctioning constructs.

items.name: Sable Core Fragment
items.description: A sliver of blackened crystal humming with enormous unstable power.

items.name: Proxy Talons
items.description: Curved metallic claws affixed to the Sable Engine’s elite guardians.

monsters.name: Quartermaster Elira
monsters.description: A soot-streaked logistics officer directing survivors with fierce clarity despite the chaos all around her.

monsters.name: Brass Hound
monsters.description: A four-legged patrol construct with red optic lenses and a jaw full of cutting gears.

monsters.name: Market Broker Hesh
monsters.description: A smooth-talking fixer in a velvet coat who always seems to know where the best salvage ends up.

monsters.name: Dockside Marauder
monsters.description: A scavenger raider prowling for abandoned supplies among the mooring chains.

monsters.name: Archive Curator Sen
monsters.description: An elderly archivist who still protects the citadel’s memory with patient determination.

monsters.name: Glass Mantis
monsters.description: A long-limbed insectile construct with razor-thin crystal forearms.

monsters.name: Tunnel Leech
monsters.description: A slick mechanical parasite drinking heat and pressure from the citadel’s failing pipes.

monsters.name: Ash Warden Captain
monsters.description: A scarred officer in dented armor, too stubborn to abandon the barracks she once commanded.

monsters.name: Sable Engine Proxy
monsters.description: A humanoid guardian wrapped in cables and black fire, animated by the reactor’s fevered will.

monsters.name: Core Revenant
monsters.description: A towering shell of brass and shadow fused together by the Sable Core’s corruption.

quests.title: Relight the Lift Network
quests.description: Recover the missing transit sigil and reach the upper relay platforms so the surviving districts can communicate again.

quests.title: Patch the Lower Pressure Lines
quests.description: The lower tunnels are close to bursting. Find the sealant and purge the worst parasite before the whole district floods.

quests.title: Break the Sable Heart
quests.description: Fight through the corrupted inner sanctum and bring down the revenant bound to the Sable Core.
